findings: GeoVista Technologies Pvt. Ltd. signed a Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) on February 13, 2025, to partner with IIIT-Hyderabad and IHub-Data to jointly develop foundational AI-based analytics IP and software focused on Geo-AI, Computer Vision, and Deep Learning for infrastructure, highways, and urban planning.
The company reports that it co-developed Mobile Video Mapping (MVM) as a data collection system and introduced it to the Indian conventional surveying industry.

The assessment rests on the company's active academic research partnership to develop proprietary Geo-AI IP and software, combined with their history of introducing localized mobile mapping tech frameworks.
